reason: Riset hanya menjelaskan aksi memotong rambut tanpa disadari dan habitat gang/kamar mandi; tidak ada wujud atau manifestasi visual pelaku. Menggambar siluet monster atau gunting melayang mengarang anatomi/atribut; rambut terpotong saja tidak menjadikan makhluk subjek.
artistic_choices: Tidak mengarang anatomi atau efek pembeda yang tidak didokumentasikan.
name: Kamikiri (haircutting)
rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.
